title: Pesticide Application Inspection Log
subtitle: Pesticide Application: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Pesticide Application Inspection Log covers site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control. The application record owner records Pesticide Application check times, results, excursions, and review. Pesticide Application Inspection Log keeps Pesticide Application exceptions visible until the application record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Pesticide Application Inspection Log at field, block, structure, treatment zone, mixing area, and buffer boundary. Document site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control identity before Pesticide Application begins. Compare site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control findings with stated Pesticide Application criteria; route unresolved Pesticide Application issues to licensed or otherwise qualified pesticide reviewer. For Pesticide Application Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Pesticide Application. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified pesticide reviewer to review Pesticide Application conditions beyond the application record owner's role.

sections.guidance: For Pesticide Application, identify responsible parties, field, block, structure, treatment zone, mixing area, and buffer boundary, and the linked site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control source.
